olivia: Heads-up — I hit a weird crash when using the async Python client with function-calling + streaming. Sync client is fine.

olivia: Minimal repro (async):
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=... )
await client.tool_call(
    name=\"parse_user\",
    input=user_prompt,
    schema={\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"id\": {\"type\": \"string\"}}},
    streaming=True,
)
```

olivia: Error I see (after a retry): ValueError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0) — looks like JSON parse failed on the function payload.

olivia: Interesting thing: the logs show a 401 on the first try, reauth succeeded, then the retry gives the JSON-parsing error. If I turn off retries it works.

sam: Which SDK version + python? Also can you paste the client debug logs around the retry?

olivia: redwood-sdk==0.13.0, python 3.11. Logs (sanitized):
```
[1690000001] -> POST /v1/tool_call (auth header ok)
[1690000002] <- 401 Unauthorized
[1690000003] reauth succeeded, retrying request
[1690000004] <- 200 OK (streaming chunks)
[1690000004] chunk: \"<html>...error page...\"\n[1690000005] parsing chunk -> raises ValueError
```

kevin: Huh. That looks like the retry path returned an HTML error page in one of the chunks, which would explain the JSON parse error. Could be the retry middleware replaying a different body/headers for streaming requests.

maya: Does the bug repro if you set streaming=False? Also does it happen with function_call=\"auto\" vs explicit schema?

olivia: streaming=False => works. With explicit schema or function name both fail in streaming mode after a retry.

kevin: Likely cause: when the HTTP client replays the request on auth, the Content-Type or chunked body isn't serialized the same, and server hits an edge-case returning HTML error mid-stream. We had a similar issue for file uploads ages ago.

sam: Can you share the exact retry config? Is this using builtin retries or a custom transport?

olivia: default client config, so builtin retries with max_attempts=3.

dev-ex-bot: Thanks for reporting — filing an issue: RDW-CL-4823 \"async streaming tool_call: retry path can replay different content and produce non-JSON chunks\". @kevin tagging for triage.

kevin: Quick workaround for now: set client.config.retries=0 or use streaming=False. I'll try to reproduce and patch the retry middleware to buffer the original stream and preserve content-type.

olivia: Thanks — workaround helps. I can add a tiny test for streaming + function-calling in CI if you want.

kevin: Please do, that would speed validation. Also if you can attach a small repro (sanitized) I'll test locally.

olivia: Pushed a tiny repro gist and test case link in thread (private link), ping me if you need access.

maya: Noted — adding to SDK compatibility matrix: mark streaming tool_call retry as flaky until fix is released.

sam: Thanks for the clear repro and logs, team. Will follow RDW-CL-4823 for updates. :thumbsup:
